providers.name: ConnectionFactory
providers.rule: every returned connection is already keyed by LLD-12 SqlCipherConnectionSecurityProvider, cipher-profile verified, safety-configured and thread-confined; callers never apply alternate keying/pragma policy

providers.name: UnitOfWork
providers.rule: begins BEGIN IMMEDIATE exactly once; repositories/participants share this connection; implicit nested UnitOfWork is forbidden

providers.name: ReadSnapshot
providers.rule: short consistent read snapshot; no writes or user/operator waiting

providers.name: OverviewReadSnapshotFactory
providers.rule: all LLD-11 owner-provider reads for one composed Overview response use the same Foundation read snapshot/connection; providers do not open independent snapshots

providers.name: MigrationRunner
providers.rule: requires data-instance ownership and keyed/verified migration connection for mutation

providers.name: MigrationStatusReader
providers.rule: strictly observational; never routes through a mutating connection factory and never creates missing instance files

providers.name: DataInstanceIdentityReader
providers.rule: returns exact opaque UUID from instance_metadata; restore preserves it and a genuinely new empty instance gets a different value; never derive from filesystem path/port/PID/descriptive data

providers.name: CommandReceiptStore
providers.rule: insert only inside authoritative UnitOfWork after authoritative revalidation/no-change decision and before dependent rows

providers.name: AuditWriter
providers.rule: no internal commit; owning packet registry validation precedes persistence

providers.name: DurableJobCoordinator
providers.rule: technical state mutations use short Foundation UnitOfWork; owning job contract controls payload/checkpoint/retry/coalescing semantics

providers.name: HostRuntime
providers.rule: Starlette/Uvicorn remain behind adapter; domain modules do not import framework runtime objects

providers.name: BackupSnapshotProvider
providers.rule: backup/restore security envelope remains LLD-12 authority; Foundation owns consistent database snapshot/verification/replacement mechanics

repository_contract: repositories return value objects, never driver row objects
repositories never commit/rollback or obtain secrets
repositories do not call external services or wait
SQL object names are static code; values always use bound parameters
application_boundary_contract: transport parses bounded request into named value object
stable error category crosses transport; raw driver/framework exception does not
